title: Stream Finance xUSD collapse and Elixir deUSD contagion in curated Morpho vaults
venues: Morpho vault ' Usual Boosted USDC' curated by MEV Capital (Ethereum, 0xd63070114470f685b75B74D60EEc7c1113d33a3D)
Euler curated xUSD markets (Plasma, Sonic and others; not quantified here)
summary: Stream Finance's xUSD and Elixir's deUSD were recursively minted against each other and were collateral in private, curator-listed Morpho and Euler markets with fixed-rate oracles. After researchers exposed the loop on 27–28 Oct 2025, lenders started pulling liquidity: the Arbitrum xUSD/USDC Morpho market hit 100% utilization on 28 Oct and the Ethereum sdeUSD/USDC market on 31 Oct. On 3 Nov xUSD began to depeg, and at 13:58 UTC the Ethereum sdeUSD/USDC market reached 100% utilization for good. Stream disclosed a $93M loss and froze withdrawals at 03:55 UTC on 4 Nov, and Elixir sunset deUSD on 6 Nov. Because the oracles never repriced, no liquidation fired. Vault depositors could still leave through other markets for days, but the vaults ran dry in bank runs. MEV Capital's ' Usual Boosted USDC' (~1% exposure) realized a 3.56% loss on 11 Nov; Relend USDC, where the frozen loan grew to 87–98% of a shrinking vault, realized a 98.4% loss on 13 Nov. Steakhouse USDC had no exposure and stayed liquid.

positions_considered.description: About $1,000 USDC in MEV Capital-curated ' Usual Boosted USDC' (Morpho, Ethereum, ~300M TVL), ~1% allocated to the sdeUSD/USDC market; no debt.
About $1,000 USDC in Relend USDC (Morpho, Ethereum, ~35–43M TVL), 6.6–12.8% allocated to sdeUSD/USDC before the run; no debt.
About $1,000 USDC in Steakhouse USDC (Morpho, Ethereum, ~480M TVL), no xUSD/deUSD exposure (control-style archetype); no debt.

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: A supplier-only position has no health factor, so an HF/LTV rule never fires. The market oracles never moved (sdeUSD oracle 1.0684 -> 1.0706, deUSD oracle fixed at 1.0000), so even borrowers in these markets were never liquidated. A rule on the xUSD market price (aggregate) would first trip on 3 Nov 12:00 (-12.6%) or 17:00 (-27%), just before or after the sdeUSD market froze at 13:58. That is too late to recover the market exposure, but early enough to exit both vaults at par, since Relend still had 70% withdrawable at 18:00.

ideal_action.rationale: Any exit at par before the 11 Nov 14:47 removal avoids the 3.56% cut; 37.2M (50.2%) was withdrawable at 14:00 that day. Exiting by 4 Nov 04:00 (74.9M withdrawable) avoids the intermittent freezes too.
Withdrawable stayed above $0.5M until 8 Nov 00:00 (0.87M); 0 at 8 Nov 12:00. Exiting on the 28 Oct warnings or the 3 Nov depeg avoids the 98% loss entirely.
No exposure; contagion only raised utilization temporarily.

data_gaps: Euler markets (TelosC, MEV Capital, Re7 and Hyperithm xUSD clusters on Plasma, Sonic and others) were not quantified: Euler data is not in the Morpho API, and no free archive RPC for Plasma or Sonic was tried.

Arbitrum MEV Capital USDC (0xa606…19Cf) removed the xUSD market on 2025-11-12 17:10:39 UTC (tx 0x4c4b18be…), but the Morpho API share price shows no drop, while MEV Capital (secondhand) reported ~600k USDC lost on ~5M remaining (~12% haircut). No free Arbitrum archive RPC was available to settle this conflict, so this vault was not used as an archetype.
MEV Capital's own X posts (exposure update; 3.6% bad debt) were not located; only WuBlockchain's quote and secondary summaries.
The Defiant article ('Utilization on hidden markets on Morpho and Euler surged to 95% to 100%... lenders could not withdraw') returned no publish time to curl or WebFetch, so it is not included.
No deUSD or sdeUSD market price series (DeFiLlama returned nothing; CoinGecko id not found). The xUSD price series is CoinGecko's aggregate, not a DEX pool read.
The 11 Oct origin of Stream's losses is only an inference from Trevee's wording; no primary record of that loss was found.
rekt.news 'House of Cards' has a date but no time. The Threshold/Elixir post-mortem on Notion and Euler's FAQ (status 1989388982783025238, 14 Nov; syndication gave only a link) were not readable.
DeFiLlama's hacks feed has no Stream or Elixir entry (it was a loss or insolvency, not a hack).
Morpho API vault totalAssets for Relend lags the on-chain removal by ~5 days; all loss times here use eth_call at the removal blocks.
The Morpho forum has no posts about Stream, xUSD or deUSD (search returned none).
source_quality: On-chain data is strong. Market utilization and supply come from Morpho API hourly series, and individual tx times from Morpho API marketTransactions. Vault withdrawable liquidity, share prices and loss events come from direct eth_call on Ethereum (eth.drpc.org) at chosen blocks. X post times are exact from status IDs, and texts come from the syndication endpoint (cut at ~280 chars for long posts). Re7 and MEV Capital statements are secondhand. News times come from page metadata, with The Block read via WebFetch. Several early warnings came from accounts outside the allowlist (Schlagonia, CBB); they are labeled as such so the lead can test allowlist coverage.
